description: This header defines utilities, classes, and functions for WebSocket testing within the Chromium project, including mock socket factories, handshake request/response generators, and test-specific stream helpers.

classes.name: WebSocketMockClientSocketFactoryMaker
classes.description: Factory class for creating mock WebSocket client sockets with specified expectations and SSL data providers.

classes.name: WebSocketTestURLRequestContextHost
classes.description: Encapsulates creation of a URLRequestContext with mock client socket handling for WebSocket tests.

classes.name: DummyConnectDelegate
classes.description: A no-op implementation of WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate for testing.

classes.name: TestWebSocketStreamRequestAPI
classes.description: Test implementation of WebSocketStreamRequestAPI that sets deterministic WebSocket handshake keys.

classes.name: TestWebSocketHandshakeStreamCreateHelper
classes.description: Subclass of WebSocketHandshakeStreamCreateHelper that uses deterministic handshake keys and dummy delegates for testing.

methods.name: WebSocketExtraHeadersToString
methods.description: Converts header key-value pairs into a single string.

methods.name: WebSocketExtraHeadersToHttpRequestHeaders
methods.description: Converts header key-value pairs into HttpRequestHeaders.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardRequest
methods.description: Generates a standard WebSocket handshake request with a fixed challenge key.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardRequestWithCookies
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket handshake request with cookies and a fixed challenge key.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardResponse
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket handshake response with matching accept headers.

methods.name: WebSocketCommonTestHeaders
methods.description: Generates common WebSocket request headers for tests.

methods.name: WebSocketHttp2Request
methods.description: Creates HTTP/2 header block for WebSocket handshake request.

methods.name: WebSocketHttp2Response
methods.description: Creates HTTP/2 header block for WebSocket handshake response.

methods.name: SetExpectations
methods.description: Sets expected written data and response data for mock sockets.

methods.name: AddRawExpectations
methods.description: Adds raw socket data expectations for mock socket creation.

methods.name: AddSSLSocketDataProvider
methods.description: Adds SSL socket data provider for mock SSL handshake.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the mock client socket factory.

methods.name: GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext configured for WebSocket tests.

methods.name: OnCreateRequest
methods.description: No-op override for WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate.

methods.name: OnSuccess
methods.description: No-op override for WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: No-op override for WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate.

methods.name: OnStartOpeningHandshake
methods.description: No-op override for WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate.

methods.name: OnSSLCertificateError
methods.description: Override for SSL error handling, does nothing.

methods.name: OnAuthRequired
methods.description: Override for auth requirement, implementation not shown.

methods.name: OnBasicHandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Sets a deterministic WebSocket key in the handshake stream.

methods.name: OnHttp2HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Sets a deterministic WebSocket key for HTTP/2 handshake stream.

methods.name: OnHttp3HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Sets a deterministic WebSocket key for HTTP/3 handshake stream.
